Canada Place in Vancouver - a long white waterfront building with a band of pale blue clerestory glazing over a row of blue-glazed bays at quay level, dark blue water lapping the base, five white fabric sail canopies with guy cables rising from the roof terrace, planters of dark green shrubs between them, and a Canadian flag on a mast among the sails.

A tugboat - a small harbour tug with a high bluff bow, a dark hull hung with round rubber tyre fenders along the side, a tan two-level deckhouse and wheelhouse, a short red funnel with a black top, a mast with a crosstree, and a towing bitt aft, lying against a timber dock.

A small log cabin in winter - horizontal log walls, a wide snow-laden gable roof, two red-framed windows lit warm yellow, a dark plank door, a bench under one window and a spruce at the corner, standing on pale blue-white ice or packed snow. It reads as a warming hut or a trapper's cabin.
A stand of coniferous trees - five spruce or fir, narrow and steeply conical with tiered layered branches and short brown trunks, standing on grey ground with a few rounded boulders.
A wooden farm fence with a gate - four grey horizontal rails on tan posts with a diagonally braced tan gate hung between two darker posts on blue hinges, standing on green grass.
A maple tree in autumn colour - a broad rounded canopy in orange and deep red over a forked brown trunk, with five pointed maple leaves lying on the ground around its base.

Toronto City Hall - the New City Hall by Viljo Revell. Two curved towers of unequal height, glazed on their concave inner faces and blank concrete on the outside, curving around a low saucer-shaped domed council chamber; both stand on a wide podium of repeated dark bays with a long blue reflecting pool in front.

A modern articulated low-floor tram or streetcar - a long red vehicle with a white band along the lower body, a black band of full-height windows, a rounded single cab end with a large dark windscreen and round headlights, roof pods, and articulation joints between three sections, on grooved street rails.

identifications.answer: A park pavilion or bandstand - a round or many-sided open structure with white classical columns, dark green louvred panels between them, a green-and-white striped conical tent roof with a scalloped valance and a white ball finial, on a stepped white base. It could equally be a carousel housing.
identifications.cues: striped conical roof with scalloped valance; ring of white columns; stepped plinth; ball finial
identifications.moreCertain: Carousel horses or a stage inside; a park setting around it.

identifications.answer: A frozen canal being skated on as a public skateway - the Rideau Canal Skateway in Ottawa is my guess. Five people in winter coats and toques skate on a broad flat sheet of ice scored with skate marks; behind them a snow bank, a mortared stone canal wall topped by a metal railing and globe lamp posts, a concrete road bridge on piers crossing overhead at the left, spruce trees, and a small wooden warming hut with a snow-covered roof.  [PARTLY PRIMED: the session's git status lists commit subjects mentioning Ottawa stops and canal locks. 'Frozen canal skateway' is what the picture shows; 'Rideau' and 'Ottawa' may be that context talking.]
identifications.cues: broad flat ice between straight stone walls - a canal, not a lake; skaters on it; lamp posts and railing along the wall; road bridge crossing over; warming hut
identifications.moreCertain: A lock, a named bridge, or a skyline. The canal geometry is what carries this, not the skaters.

identifications.answer: An historic white civic building - a town hall, court house or colonial legislature. A low white rectangular block with a dark hipped roof and rows of tall dark windows, a stone basement course, and a central clock tower rising in stages: a columned open stage, then a square stage with a dark blue clock face with gold hands, then an arcaded lantern under a green copper dome with a gold finial. Grass in front. I cannot name it.
identifications.cues: central clock tower with a green copper dome; blue clock face with gold hands; colonnaded stage below the clock; low white Georgian block
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; the plan of the building; whether the tower is attached or free-standing.

identifications.answer: A lighthouse - a white tapered tower with three narrow dark windows up its shaft, a white gallery deck with a black railing, a red lantern room with a red roof and a red finial, and a small white flat-roofed outbuilding at its base. If it is a named one I would guess Peggy's Point lighthouse in Nova Scotia.
identifications.cues: tapered white tower; red lantern room and roof; railed gallery; attached keeper's outbuilding
identifications.moreCertain: The granite shore at Peggy's Cove, or the tower being octagonal rather than round, which is the detail that would decide it.

identifications.answer: A Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer - a Mountie in red serge, drawn with dark skin and dark hair. Scarlet tunic, brown belt with a brass buckle and a cross-strap over the shoulder, a hip pouch, dark blue breeches with a yellow leg stripe, tall brown riding boots. No hat on this one - the head is bare.
identifications.cues: scarlet tunic with blue collar; Sam Browne belt and cross-strap; blue breeches with a yellow stripe; brown riding boots
identifications.moreCertain: The campaign hat, which is missing here; without it the uniform could be read as another ceremonial red tunic.

identifications.answer: The same modern museum or science-centre building as another render in this set, at a smaller size: curved glass wing on the left, angular stepped stone block with diagonal ribbon windows on the right, and a steel lattice derrick on a blue cone above the roof. Still unnamed.
identifications.cues: lattice derrick on the roof; curved glass wing; stepped angular massing
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render, or a setting.

identifications.answer: The same waterside pavilion on piles as another render in this set, smaller: dark glazed ground floor, wide white overhanging roof with a clerestory box, white-railed terrace and outside stair, globe lamps, conifers, and frozen water with skate tracks in front.  [Same priming caveat as the larger render: the branch name put a lakeside pavilion in my head before I looked.]
identifications.cues: pavilion on piles; wide roof with clerestory; railed terrace; ice with skate tracks
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; anything naming the water body.

identifications.answer: A paddle-wheel steamboat - a white multi-deck river steamer with rows of dark windows, a tall funnel, masts and rigging, and a large orange-brown paddle wheel at one end. Drawn small; I cannot name the vessel.
identifications.cues: large spoked paddle wheel; stacked white decks with window rows; funnel and rigging
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; whether the wheel is at the stern or on the side; a name board.

identifications.answer: A downtown cycling street: a separated bike lane with bicycle symbols and arrows painted on the asphalt, a bike-share docking station with a row of blue bicycles, a cyclist in red riding past, people standing on a green verge, benches, street trees, lamp posts and information sign boards, with a skyline of blue and white glass office towers behind.
identifications.cues: bike symbols painted in the lane; bike-share dock with matching bicycles; separated lane markings; office-tower skyline
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a recognisable tower in the skyline to say which city.

identifications.answer: A fenced green field with rows of posts and overhead wires strung between taller poles, and something small and red in the middle. It could be a vineyard, a fenced pasture or a rail corridor. Far too small to be sure of anything.
identifications.cues: repeated line of posts; catenary or fence wires between taller poles; flat green ground
identifications.moreCertain: Almost anything - this is at the bottom of the size ladder and the subject does not survive it.

identifications.answer: The CN Tower in Toronto, with the Rogers Centre (SkyDome) beside it. A very tall slender tapering concrete shaft with a white saucer-shaped observation pod near the top, a narrower shaft above that and a thin antenna mast at the summit; at its foot a low white retractable-dome stadium on a dark colonnaded base, a green street tree, and a small blue-glass office slab.
identifications.cues: tapering concrete shaft with a saucer pod and antenna mast - the CN Tower silhouette; white domed stadium immediately beside it; the pairing of the two is the identification
identifications.moreCertain: The sky pod's second smaller deck; the lake in front.

identifications.answer: A chateau-style grand railway hotel on a cliff top. Red-brown brick with pale stone banding, steep green copper roofs with dormers, four round corner turrets with green conical caps and finials, a ground-floor arcade of tall arched windows, and a central bay with a big arched carriage entrance. Snow on the roofs and a rocky slope with conifers below. The obvious candidate is the Chateau Frontenac in Quebec City, but the tall central tower that names that building is not in this picture.
identifications.cues: chateauesque brick and green copper roofs; conical corner turrets with finials; arched ground-floor arcade; cliff-top siting with evergreens
identifications.moreCertain: The central tower. Without it this is a chateau-style hotel in general rather than a named one.

identifications.answer: A group of four steel farm grain bins - hopper-bottomed storage bins with conical roofs and small vent caps, standing on steel legs over a pale stubble field, one with a ladder up its side.
identifications.cues: conical roofs with vent caps; hopper cones on legs; side ladder; stubble field
identifications.moreCertain: An auger, a grain truck, or a farmyard behind them.

identifications.answer: A pair of canal lock gates seen head-on - two white mitre gates meeting in a shallow V between mortared stone lock walls, with horizontal cross-braces on the gate leaves, a small dark fitting where they meet, and a dark balance beam on the coping at each side. The water below is frozen white with a strip of blue.
identifications.cues: mitre gates meeting in a V; balance beams on the lock coping; stone chamber walls either side
identifications.moreCertain: The lock chamber in perspective, a boat, or the winding gear - which canal it is cannot be told from this.

identifications.answer: A coastal seawall promenade. A wide paved path along a low white picket railing, with wooden benches, twin-globe lamp posts and tall spruce trees; four people stand looking out over blue water where a white passenger ferry and a dark red cargo ship are passing, with gulls, a forested shore and mountains behind and a faint city skyline on the far side. It reads like the Stanley Park seawall in Vancouver, but I am guessing at the city.
identifications.cues: seawall path with railing and benches; ferry and freighter on the inlet; forested mountain shore opposite; conifers
identifications.moreCertain: Mountains with a recognisable profile, a suspension bridge, or the city skyline drawn properly rather than as a silhouette.

identifications.answer: An urban waterfront promenade in autumn - a stone-paved walkway with a low stone parapet, twin street lamps, wooden benches, three big broadleaf trees in orange and green autumn colour, and small groups of people walking and sitting, with a band of water and a skyline of grey and blue mid-rise office towers behind. A city river or lakeside park path; I cannot name the city.
identifications.cues: stone parapet and paved promenade; autumn broadleaf trees; benches and lamps; generic office-tower skyline across the water
identifications.moreCertain: A named landmark in the skyline; a bridge.

identifications.answer: The Centre Block on Parliament Hill in Ottawa, with the Peace Tower. A pale sandstone Gothic Revival parliament building: a long symmetrical wing of pointed-arch windows under a green copper roof with dormers, square corner towers with green pyramidal caps, and a tall central clock tower with a white clock face, corner pinnacles and a green copper spire; a separate dark slate spire rises behind the wing on the right. Snow and conifers along the front.  [PRIMED: docs/art-verification-method.md names Parliament Hill, the Peace Tower and the Centre Block, and I read it before this run. The reading above is mine from the pixels but the name was available to me.]
identifications.cues: tall central clock tower with green copper spire; Gothic Revival arcade under a long green copper roof; sandstone colour; symmetrical wings with corner towers
identifications.moreCertain: The Library rotunda at the back; the flag on the tower.

identifications.answer: A person ice skating - gliding forward on one skate with the other leg trailing behind, arms out for balance. Blue winter coat with white cuffs and hem, red scarf, red mittens, grey trousers, brown boots with visible skate blades, and a white helmet.
identifications.cues: skate blades under the boots; one-foot gliding pose with the trailing leg lifted; winter coat, mittens and helmet
identifications.moreCertain: Ice under the skates.

identifications.answer: Two cartoon figures standing side by side, and they are not the same character. On the left a person dressed for winter: blue parka with white cuffs and hem, red scarf, red mitten, grey trousers, brown boots with skate blades, white helmet. On the right a Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer in red serge: scarlet tunic, tan campaign hat, Sam Browne belt and cross-strap, hip pouch, blue breeches with a yellow leg stripe, brown riding boots. If this render is meant to show one subject in two variants, it does not - it shows a skater and a Mountie.
identifications.cues: left figure has skate blades and winter clothing; right figure has the campaign hat, scarlet tunic and striped breeches
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing about the identification - but I would like to know whether one render is supposed to hold two different subjects.

identifications.answer: The same port immigration or ferry terminal scene as another render in this set, smaller: an ocean liner with funnels on the left, a green railway passenger coach on tracks, a red brick terminal building with an arched entrance, and a low white shed on the right.
identifications.cues: liner funnels; green rail coach; brick terminal with arch
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: The Library of Parliament in Ottawa, smaller: the sixteen-sided sandstone chapter-house with buttress pinnacles, pointed-arch windows, a steep conical roof with gabled dormers and a finialled lantern, standing in snow.  [Same priming caveat: the method document I read names this building.]
identifications.cues: polygonal plan; conical roof with lantern; buttress pinnacles; pointed-arch windows
identifications.moreCertain: The connecting corridor to the Centre Block.

identifications.answer: The same coastal seawall promenade as another render in this set, at a small size: railing, benches, lamps, conifers, people looking out at a white ferry and a red freighter on blue water with a forested shore beyond.
identifications.cues: seawall railing and benches; ferry and freighter; forested far shore
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A public toboggan slide below a boardwalk terrace - I think the Dufferin Terrace slide in Quebec City. A heavy timber launch tower with cross-bracing stands at the left end of a wide wooden boardwalk edged with an ornate dark green cast-iron railing, green lamp posts carrying clusters of white globes, white park benches and a small pavilion shelter where two people sit. Below the boardwalk a long snow slope is divided into parallel lanes by low banks, with five people riding wooden toboggans down them.
identifications.cues: timber launch tower at the head of the run; snow lanes separated by banks with toboggans on them; ornate green iron railing and globe lamp clusters along a boardwalk above
identifications.moreCertain: The chateau hotel that stands behind that terrace, or the river below it. The slide plus the green ironwork is what points me at Quebec City.

identifications.answer: A shoreline: a dense dark wall of conifer forest along the top, a pale sandy bank, a band of turquoise water, and a grey rocky or gravel foreshore with clumps of green and yellow vegetation. A lake or river edge in boreal forest country. Far too small to name.
identifications.cues: solid conifer treeline; turquoise water band; rocky foreshore with low scrub
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; mountains or a distinctive shoreline shape.

identifications.answer: A small-town or city street frontage - a row of two- and three-storey buildings in white, grey and orange-brown brick with shopfronts at street level, street trees and people on the sidewalk. Far too small to name.
identifications.cues: terraced street frontage of mixed-colour facades; ground-floor shopfronts; street trees
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A beaver - cartoon, standing upright in profile with a flat dark cross-hatched paddle tail, buck teeth and small rounded ears. Same figure as another render in this set.
identifications.cues: flat scaly paddle tail; prominent upper incisors; stocky brown body
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A red timber farm barn with a grey roof and a red roof cupola, a pale sliding door, small windows, an open lean-to bay on the right with stall fronts, a wooden rail fence enclosing a dirt yard, and a grey horse standing at the fence.
identifications.cues: red board barn with roof cupola; rail-fenced yard; horse in the paddock; lean-to stalls
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; whether the roof is gambrel; a silo or a farmhouse beside it.

identifications.answer: A prairie wooden grain elevator. A tall square rust-red timber headhouse with a small hipped cupola vent on top and yellow-trimmed eaves, a long low annex sloping away to the left, a grey loading spout arm hinged out from the right side, a driveway door at the base, and a railway siding running along the front.
identifications.cues: square headhouse taller than the annex with a cupola vent; hinged loading spout over the siding; rail track at the base; rust-red board cladding
identifications.moreCertain: The town name painted on the headhouse, which is exactly what these carry in life; a grain truck at the driveway.

identifications.answer: A bulk cargo ship - a long dark red laker or freighter with a low hull, four deck cranes with raised booms over covered hatches, a white multi-deck superstructure aft with a black-topped orange funnel and a mast, lying alongside a dock in blue water.
identifications.cues: long low hull with hatch covers; four deck cranes; aft superstructure and funnel; dock wall in front
identifications.moreCertain: Whether the bow is bluff (a Great Lakes laker) or raked ocean-going; a lock or a canal around it.

identifications.answer: A beaver - cartoon, standing upright on its hind feet in profile, brown fur with a pale belly, small round ears, two large upper incisors, and a broad flat dark cross-hatched paddle tail trailing behind.
identifications.cues: flat cross-hatched paddle tail; buck teeth; upright stance; small rounded ears
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing - the tail and teeth together are decisive.

identifications.answer: Glacier-smoothed boulders on bare rock - two large rounded grey-brown erratics sitting on a flat pale bedrock shelf with a small blue pool of water in front. A Canadian Shield or granite-coast outcrop. Not a named place as far as I can tell.
identifications.cues: rounded boulders resting on flat bedrock; a shallow rock pool; no soil or vegetation
identifications.moreCertain: The coast, a lighthouse, or striations on the rock - whether this is a tide-washed headland or an inland shield outcrop is not decidable here.

identifications.answer: A lighthouse - tapered white tower with a railed gallery, a red lantern room with a red roof and finial, dark slit windows, and a small white outbuilding at the base. Same tower as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: white tapered tower; red lantern and roof; gallery railing
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a shoreline.

identifications.answer: A person skateboarding in winter clothing - riding a black deck with white wheels, one foot forward, arms out. Blue parka with white cuffs, red scarf, red mittens, grey trousers, brown boots with white cuffs, and a white helmet.
identifications.cues: skateboard deck with two visible wheel trucks; riding stance; helmet, scarf and mittens
identifications.moreCertain: Ground or a street under the board.

identifications.answer: A railway level crossing in open country - a ballasted single track with a white crossbuck warning sign and a signal post beside it, wooden telegraph poles carrying wires along the line, and a low green hedge behind. Too small to name a place.
identifications.cues: crossbuck sign at the trackside; ballast and rails; telegraph poles and wires along the right of way
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a train; a station.

identifications.answer: A saddled horse - a bay with a dark mane, tail and lower legs, standing in profile with its head turned slightly toward the viewer. It wears a pale tan saddle with a stirrup hanging, a girth, and a bridle with reins and a bit.
identifications.cues: saddle with stirrup and girth; bridle and reins; bay colouring with dark points
identifications.moreCertain: A rider, or a saddle type clear enough to say Western versus English.

identifications.answer: A Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer - a Mountie in red serge, drawn with dark skin. Tan broad-brimmed campaign hat, scarlet tunic, brown Sam Browne belt with a cross-strap and a hip pouch, dark blue breeches with a yellow leg stripe, tall brown riding boots.
identifications.cues: campaign hat; scarlet tunic; Sam Browne cross-strap; yellow-striped blue breeches; riding boots
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing.

identifications.answer: The same modern museum or science-centre building as earlier renders in this set: a curved pale-blue glass wing on the left, an angular stepped stone block with diagonal ribbon windows and a dark blue entrance, and a steel lattice derrick on a blue cone above the roof. identifications.cues: roof-mounted lattice derrick; curved glass wing; stepped angular massing; diagonal ribbon windows
identifications.moreCertain: A setting - a river, foothills or a city - or a signature detail beyond the derrick.

identifications.answer: Two white fishing boats tied up at a wharf - long low white hulls with tall slender masts and small wheelhouses, on blue water beside a brown dock. Drawn small.
identifications.cues: tall bare masts on low white hulls; wheelhouse forward; wharf in front
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; nets, traps or booms to say what kind of fishing.

identifications.answer: The same downtown cycling street as another render in this set, smaller: a painted separated bike lane, a bike-share dock with blue bicycles, a cyclist in red, people, trees and a glass-tower skyline.
identifications.cues: bike lane markings; bike-share dock; office towers behind
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A close crop of a mortared ashlar stone wall corner with snow on its coping and on the ground below - brown stone on the left return face, pale grey-brown stone on the right. Almost everything has been cropped or painted away; this is a wall and nothing more can honestly be said.
identifications.cues: coursed ashlar blocks; snow capping; an inside corner
identifications.moreCertain: Anything above or beside the wall - a gate, a railing, water.

A white A-frame Samson post carries a walking beam with a red horse-head at the front and a red counterweight crank at the back, a black gearbox and prime mover on the base, an orange ladder up the frame, and a wellhead with a bridle and polished rod at the right, on a gravel pad in a green field.
identifications.cues: red horse-head on a walking beam; A-frame Samson post; counterweight crank; wellhead and polished rod
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing - the horse-head and the A-frame are unmistakable.

identifications.answer: A passenger railway dome car - a long silver coach with a blue window band, standing on rails, with a raised glazed observation dome on the roof over the centre and a vestibule at the right end.
identifications.cues: raised roof dome over the middle of the coach; stainless-look body with a blue window band; bogies on rail
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a locomotive; a railway name on the letterboard.

identifications.answer: I cannot tell. At this size I can make out a row of small red and white buildings behind a green treeline, with pale grey ground or water in front and something blue near the middle. It could be a wharf with fishing sheds, a village street, or a rail yard. Too small to answer honestly.
identifications.cues: red and white structures in a row; dark green treeline; pale foreground
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render. This is below the size at which the subject survives.

identifications.answer: The same toboggan slide and boardwalk as another render in this set, smaller: a timber launch tower at the left, a boardwalk with a green railing, lamp posts and a small shelter, and people riding wooden sleds down lanes of snow below.
identifications.cues: timber launch tower; green railing along a boardwalk; sledders on snow lanes
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A vineyard - rows of vines trained along wire trellises on posts, running across a green and tan field with low green hills behind, and small red machines or bins among the rows. Drawn small.
identifications.cues: parallel trellis rows on posts; regular vine spacing; rolling hills behind
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; grape bunches; a winery building.

identifications.answer: An oil pumpjack on a well pad in a green field - white A-frame, red horse-head on the walking beam, red counterweight, black gearbox, orange ladder, and a wellhead to the right. Smaller version of another render in this set.
identifications.cues: red horse-head; A-frame; counterweight; wellhead
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing much.

identifications.answer: The Centre Block on Parliament Hill in Ottawa, with the Peace Tower, and the Canadian flag flying from the tower's spire. Pale sandstone Gothic Revival front with pointed-arch windows under a long green copper roof, square corner towers with green caps, a tall central clock tower with a white clock face and a green copper spire, a dark slate spire behind the right wing, and a red-and-white maple leaf flag on the flagpole at the summit.  [PRIMED: the method document I read names Parliament Hill and the Peace Tower before I saw any render.]
identifications.cues: Canadian maple leaf flag on the tower; tall central clock tower with green spire; Gothic Revival arcade under a green copper roof; sandstone colour
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing. Note that the same building appears elsewhere in this set without the flag, and the flag is clearly doing a lot of the work.

identifications.answer: A railway container flatcar carrying double-stacked intermodal containers - a grey well car on two bogies on ballasted track, with a blue shipping container in the well and a red-brown one stacked on top of it.
identifications.cues: two stacked corrugated shipping containers; flat well car with end bolsters; rail bogies on sleepered track
identifications.moreCertain: A container door end, or a second car, to confirm double-stack rather than a single deep load.

identifications.answer: A person riding a bicycle in winter clothing - leaning forward over the handlebars of a brown-framed bike with spoked wheels, wearing a blue coat, red mittens, dark trousers and a white helmet.
identifications.cues: two spoked wheels with a frame and handlebars; forward riding posture; helmet and mittens
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a road surface.

identifications.cues: spoked pickup reel on the header; unloading auger arm; big front drive wheel and small rear wheel; cut stubble under it
identifications.moreCertain: A grain cart or truck alongside; the header's cutter bar.

identifications.answer: Three beef cattle in a pasture - Hereford type, red-brown bodies with white faces, white underlines and white socks, standing in profile on green grass, drawn at three sizes so one reads as a calf.
identifications.cues: white face on a red-brown body - the Hereford marking; white belly band and socks; grazing stance on pasture
identifications.moreCertain: Horns or their absence; an ear tag; a fence.

identifications.cues: heavy parka with cuffs; scarf and mittens; winter boots
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing identifying - there is no role marker on this figure at all.

identifications.answer: A fishing wharf - a small dark red shed or fish house with a grey pitched roof standing on a timber wharf deck, a white railing to the left, stacks of teal-coloured lobster traps or crates along the wharf edge, and a grey ramp or slipway at the right. Drawn small.

identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; boats; buoys.

identifications.moreCertain: A cruise ship berthed alongside, or the North Shore mountains behind.

identifications.answer: A cable-stayed bridge - one tall white pylon leaning back from the middle with fans of thin stay cables running down to a white deck with a railing, crossing dark blue water above a brick or stone quay wall. I cannot name it.
identifications.cues: single inclined pylon; symmetrical cable fans; white deck and railing; blue water over a quay
identifications.moreCertain: A skyline, a river name, or the pylon's section. A single leaning mast is a common type.

identifications.answer: A harbourfront boardwalk in a small coastal town. identifications.answer: A small render of a waterside park path - a green verge and a pale railing along dark blue water with white boats on it, trees and lamp posts. Too small to say more; it is probably the same seawall or promenade as other renders here.
identifications.cues: green verge and railing; dark water with boats; trees and lamps

identifications.moreCertain: A towline, or a barge behind it.

identifications.cues: parka, scarf, mittens, winter boots

identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a chimney with smoke; a lake or a trail.

identifications.answer: A small log cabin in winter - horizontal log walls, a wide snow-laden gable roof, two red-framed windows lit warm yellow, a dark plank door, a bench under one window and a spruce at the corner, standing on pale blue-white ice or packed snow. It reads as a warming hut or a trapper's cabin.
identifications.cues: log wall coursing; deep snow on the roof; warmly lit windows; spruce; ice underfoot
identifications.moreCertain: A stove pipe, snowshoes, or a setting - a lake, a canal, a trail - to say what it is for.

identifications.answer: A pair of canal lock gates between stone lock walls, with balance beams on the coping and frozen water below. Same subject as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: mitre gates in a V; balance beams; stone chamber walls
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: Canada Place in Vancouver, smaller - the long white waterfront building with its row of five white sail canopies, a blue glazed band, rooftop planters, and a small red-and-white Canadian flag on one of the masts.
identifications.cues: five white sail canopies; long blue-glazed waterfront block; Canadian flag on a mast
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; mountains behind.

identifications.answer: An urban waterfront promenade in autumn with orange and green trees, benches, lamps, people and a grey office-tower skyline across the water. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: stone promenade; autumn trees; generic skyline
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a named landmark.

identifications.answer: Two large rounded boulders on a flat bedrock shelf with a blue rock pool in front. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: rounded boulders on bare rock; rock pool
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a coastline.

identifications.answer: A northern river or lake shore. A dense wall of dark spruce forest along the far bank with a few gold-leaved trees among them, a sandy cut bank below it, a broad pale turquoise channel of water with current streaks, and a near shore of grey gravel and cobbles with low dark green shrubs bearing yellow berries and tufts of grass. Boreal or subarctic country; I cannot name it.
identifications.cues: black spruce treeline; glacial turquoise water; gravel foreshore with low berry shrubs; cut sand bank
identifications.moreCertain: Mountains, a canoe, a settlement - anything to place it. The water colour suggests glacial melt but that is a guess.

identifications.answer: A stack of milled lumber with a circular saw blade at the left end, on a grey deck with offcuts scattered around. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: criss-crossed squared timber; saw blade; offcuts
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A stand of coniferous trees - five spruce or fir, narrow and steeply conical with tiered layered branches and short brown trunks, standing on grey ground with a few rounded boulders.
identifications.cues: narrow steep conical crowns with tiered branch layers - spruce or fir rather than pine; short bare trunks; boulders on the ground
identifications.moreCertain: Cones, or a needle detail, to separate spruce from fir.

identifications.answer: A railway level crossing in farm country. Ballasted track in the foreground, a white crossbuck sign with a black-and-red signal head carrying two red lights on a white post, four wooden telegraph poles with crossarms and insulators carrying wires along the line, a wooden post-and-rail fence, a strip of green and brown ploughed field, and a low hedge of shrubs behind.
identifications.cues: crossbuck sign with paired red flashing lights; ballast and rails; telegraph poles with crossarms; fenced farmland beside the right of way
identifications.moreCertain: A crossing road - there is a sign for a crossing but no road crossing the track in this picture, which is odd.

identifications.answer: An oil pumpjack on a well pad - white A-frame, red horse-head, red counterweight, black gearbox, orange ladder, wellhead at the right, on grass. Same as other renders in this set.
identifications.cues: red horse-head; A-frame; counterweight; wellhead
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing.

identifications.answer: A beaver with its teeth painted out. The animal is a beaver - upright stance, brown fur with a pale belly, small round ears, and a broad flat dark cross-hatched paddle tail - but a plain white rectangle covers the muzzle where the incisors would be. With the teeth masked I would still say beaver, on the tail alone; without the tail I would be lost.
identifications.cues: flat cross-hatched paddle tail (decisive); heavy upright body; small round ears; white mask over the mouth
identifications.moreCertain: The teeth, which are exactly what has been removed. The tail carries this identification by itself.

identifications.answer: A small harbour town waterfront with a boardwalk, bollards, lamp posts, people, a kiosk, moored boats and gabled houses with a church steeple behind. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: boardwalk with bollards; kiosk; gabled townscape
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A person dressed for winter, standing - dark skin, a red knitted toque with a white pompom, a blue parka with white cuffs, a red scarf, a red mitten, grey trousers with white boot cuffs and brown boots.
identifications.cues: knitted toque with pompom; parka, scarf, mittens; winter boots
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing identifying beyond winter clothing.

identifications.answer: A wooden farm fence with a gate - horizontal rails on posts with a diagonally braced five-bar gate in the middle, standing on green grass. Nothing else in the picture.
identifications.cues: post-and-rail fence; braced gate; grass
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; the field or stock it encloses.

identifications.answer: A person ice skating - gliding on one skate with the trailing leg lifted, arms out, in a blue winter coat with white cuffs, red mitten, brown boots with skate blades and a white helmet. Same figure as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: skate blades; one-foot glide pose; winter clothing
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; ice.

identifications.answer: The CN Tower in Toronto with the Rogers Centre beside it - the tapering concrete shaft with a dark-banded saucer pod and a long antenna mast, a white domed stadium on a dark colonnaded base at its foot, a green tree, and a small blue-glass office block. Smaller than the other render of this scene.
identifications.cues: tapering shaft with saucer pod and antenna; adjacent white dome stadium
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: Two figures side by side: on the left a beaver, cartoon, upright, brown with a pale belly, buck teeth and a flat cross-hatched paddle tail; on the right a person in winter clothes - blue parka, red scarf, red mittens, grey trousers, brown boots, no hat. Two different subjects in one picture.
identifications.cues: the beaver's paddle tail and incisors; the person's parka, scarf and mittens
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing about the identification, but again I would like to know whether one render is meant to carry two subjects.

identifications.answer: A prairie wooden grain elevator - a tall square rust-red timber headhouse with a cupola vent and yellow eaves trim, a long low annex sloping to the left, a hinged grey loading spout on the right, a driveway door at the base, and a track along the front. Smaller than the other render of this subject.
identifications.cues: square headhouse with cupola; hinged loading spout; long annex; rust-red boarding
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a town name on the headhouse.

identifications.answer: A beaver with its incisors masked out by a white rectangle - otherwise the same figure: upright, brown with a pale belly, small round ears, and a broad flat dark cross-hatched paddle tail. I still read it as a beaver, because of the tail.
identifications.cues: cross-hatched paddle tail (decisive with the teeth gone); heavy upright rodent body; white mask over the mouth
identifications.moreCertain: The teeth, which are what has been removed. Masking them costs me confidence but not the answer.

identifications.answer: The Library of Parliament in Ottawa, small - the polygonal sandstone chapter-house with buttress pinnacles, pointed-arch windows, a steep conical roof with gabled dormers and a finialled lantern, standing in snow.  [Same priming caveat: the method document names this building.]
identifications.cues: polygonal plan; conical roof with lantern; buttress pinnacles
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer - a Mountie in red serge, dark skin, with the middle of the figure painted out so only the head and torso and the boots remain. Tan broad-brimmed campaign hat, scarlet tunic with a dark blue shoulder yoke, white cross-strap, brown belt with a brass buckle, brown riding boots with straps below.
identifications.cues: campaign hat; scarlet tunic; cross-strap and belt; riding boots
identifications.moreCertain: The yellow-striped breeches, which are exactly what the mask removes.

identifications.answer: A maple tree in autumn colour - a broad rounded canopy in orange and deep red over a forked brown trunk, with five pointed maple leaves lying on the ground around its base.
identifications.cues: the fallen leaves are unmistakably maple - pointed lobes with deep sinuses; orange and red autumn canopy; forked trunk
identifications.moreCertain: Leaf shape in the canopy itself rather than only on the ground; a key or samara.

identifications.answer: The same historic white civic building with the columned clock tower, blue clock face and green copper dome, smaller. A town hall, court house or colonial legislature; I cannot name it.
identifications.cues: green copper dome over a clock stage; colonnaded tower; low white block
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; anything naming the place.

identifications.answer: I cannot tell. A thin strip of green field with darker green rows and a pale yellow band below. Possibly the vineyard from another render in this set, but at this size nothing is legible.
identifications.cues: green banded ground; nothing else survives
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render. The subject does not survive this size.

identifications.answer: A maple tree in autumn - orange and red rounded canopy on a forked brown trunk with maple leaves fallen around the base. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: maple-shaped fallen leaves; orange autumn canopy
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: Two figures side by side: on the left a Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer in red serge - tan campaign hat, scarlet tunic, Sam Browne belt and cross-strap, hip pouch, blue breeches with a yellow leg stripe, brown riding boots, light skin and blonde hair; on the right a person in winter clothes - blue parka, red scarf, red mittens, grey trousers, brown boots, dark skin and dark hair. Two different subjects in one render.
identifications.cues: left: campaign hat, scarlet tunic, striped breeches; right: parka, scarf, mittens
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing about the identification.

identifications.answer: A Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer with the hat painted out. The scarlet tunic, dark blue shoulder yoke, white cross-strap, brown Sam Browne belt with a brass buckle, hip pouch, dark blue breeches with a yellow leg stripe and tall brown riding boots are all there; only the campaign hat is missing, leaving bare blonde hair. I still read Mountie, from the tunic and the striped breeches.
identifications.cues: scarlet tunic with blue yoke; cross-strap and belt; blue breeches with yellow stripe; riding boots; hat masked out
identifications.moreCertain: The hat, which is what has been removed. Without it the uniform is close to several other ceremonial red tunics, and the yellow leg stripe is doing most of the work.

identifications.answer: A child tobogganing - seated leaning back on a wooden sled with an upcurled front runner, wearing a blue winter coat and snow pants, a red scarf, red mittens, grey boots and a white helmet.
identifications.cues: wooden sled with a curled runner; seated sledding pose; winter clothing and helmet
identifications.moreCertain: Snow, or a slope, under the sled.

identifications.answer: The CN Tower in Toronto with the Rogers Centre. A very tall tapering concrete shaft with a white saucer observation pod banded in dark grey, a slimmer shaft above it and a long antenna mast; at its foot a white-domed stadium on a dark colonnaded base, a green tree and a small blue-glass slab.
identifications.cues: tapering shaft with saucer pod and antenna mast; the domed stadium immediately beside it
identifications.moreCertain: Lake Ontario in front; the second smaller sky pod deck.

identifications.answer: A small log cabin with a snowy gable roof, warm-lit windows in red frames, a dark door and a spruce beside it, on ice or snow. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: log walls; snow on the roof; lit windows; spruce
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: Toronto City Hall - the 1965 New City Hall by Viljo Revell. Two curved concrete towers of unequal height, their glazed inner faces facing each other, curling around a low saucer-shaped domed council chamber that sits on a broad podium of repeated dark bays, with a rectangular blue reflecting pool along the front.
identifications.cues: two unequal curved towers embracing a saucer dome between them - that arrangement is unique to this building; podium with a reflecting pool in front
identifications.moreCertain: Nathan Phillips Square's arches, or the old City Hall clock tower beside it.

identifications.answer: The same green-and-white striped round pavilion on white columns with a stepped base and a ball finial - a bandstand or carousel housing - smaller.
identifications.cues: striped conical roof; ring of columns; stepped plinth
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; what is inside it.

identifications.answer: A railway well car carrying double-stacked shipping containers - a blue container in the well with a red-brown one stacked on top, on a grey car with bogies, on ballasted track.
identifications.cues: two stacked corrugated containers; well car; bogies on track
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A lighthouse - a white tapered tower with three narrow dark windows, a white gallery deck with a black railing, a red lantern room with a hipped red roof and a red ball finial, and a small white flat-roofed outbuilding with a dark door at the base. I would guess a Nova Scotia light such as Peggy's Point, but the tower is drawn round rather than octagonal.
identifications.cues: tapered white tower; red lantern room and roof; black gallery railing; attached keeper's outbuilding
identifications.moreCertain: An octagonal tower section and a granite shore would make Peggy's Cove decidable; as drawn this is a generic Canadian coastal light.

identifications.answer: A sternwheel paddle steamer - a white multi-deck river steamer with rows of windows, a tall funnel, a wheelhouse on top, a spar or derrick rigging forward, and a large yellow-brown spoked paddle wheel at the stern end on the left.
identifications.cues: large spoked paddle wheel at one end of the hull - a sternwheeler; stacked white decks with window rows; funnel and wheelhouse
identifications.moreCertain: A river, a landing stage, or a name board. Sternwheelers of this kind ran on the Yukon and the western rivers, but nothing in the picture says which.

identifications.answer: A pile of pale squared lumber on a grey deck. Same as other renders in this set, at the bottom of the size ladder - the saw blade is no longer legible and it is barely more than a heap of sticks.
identifications.cues: criss-crossed pale timber on a dark deck
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render. The saw blade that carried the sawmill reading has vanished at this size.

identifications.answer: A modern articulated low-floor tram or streetcar - a long red vehicle with a white stripe along its lower body and a black band of full-height windows, a sloped cab end with a dark windscreen and headlights, and articulation joints between sections, standing on street rails. The livery is red with white, which is Toronto's streetcar colour scheme.
identifications.cues: articulated low-floor body with joints; street track rather than ballast; red and white livery; sloped single-ended cab
identifications.moreCertain: A route number, a pantograph, or a street around it.

identifications.answer: A modern articulated low-floor tram or streetcar - a long red vehicle with a white band along the lower body, a black band of full-height windows, a rounded single cab end with a large dark windscreen and round headlights, roof pods, and articulation joints between three sections, on grooved street rails.
identifications.cues: articulated low-floor sections; grooved street track; red body with a white band; single sloped cab end
identifications.moreCertain: A pantograph or trolley pole - none is drawn, which is odd for a streetcar; a route number; a street.

identifications.answer: A large rodent with its tail painted out - upright stance, brown fur with a pale belly, small round ears and two prominent upper incisors, but the whole tail area is blanked. Without the tail I would say a beaver OR a groundhog or marmot, and I could not choose between them with any confidence. The tail is what makes this animal identifiable.
identifications.cues: buck teeth and round ears; heavy upright body; NO tail - it has been masked
identifications.moreCertain: The tail. This mask is the informative one: removing it drops me from a confident beaver to a coin flip between beaver and groundhog.

identifications.answer: A wooden farm fence with a gate - four grey horizontal rails on tan posts with a diagonally braced tan gate hung between two darker posts on blue hinges, standing on green grass.
identifications.cues: post-and-rail fence; diagonally braced gate with hinges; grass
identifications.moreCertain: What it encloses - a paddock, a field, a corral.

identifications.answer: A saddled bay horse standing in profile - dark mane, tail and lower legs, a tan saddle with a stirrup, a girth and a bridle with reins. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: saddle with stirrup; bridle and reins; bay with dark points
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A saddled bay horse in profile, small - dark points, a tan saddle and a bridle. Same subject as other renders here, further down the size ladder.
identifications.cues: saddle shape on the back; bridle; horse silhouette
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; the stirrup and reins are nearly gone at this size.

identifications.answer: A tugboat at a dock - dark hull with round tyre fenders along the side, a tan deckhouse and wheelhouse, a short red funnel with a black top and a mast. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: tyre fenders; tall wheelhouse on a stubby hull; red funnel
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; a tow.

identifications.answer: A fishing wharf - a small dark red gable-roofed fish shed with a white-trimmed door and window standing on a plank wharf deck, a white railing to the left, stacks of teal-painted lobster traps piled under the deck edge, blue water and a grey boulder to the right.
identifications.cues: red fish shed on a timber wharf; stacked lobster traps; white railing; water below the deck
identifications.moreCertain: Boats, buoys, or a harbour behind. The stacked traps are what make it a lobster wharf rather than a generic boathouse.

identifications.answer: An historic white civic building with a clock tower. A low white rectangular block on a stone basement, with a dark hipped roof and tall dark-paned sash windows, a brown central door up a few steps, and a tower rising in stages above it: a stage of white columns around a window, then a white stage with a dark blue clock face with gold hands and dark louvres either side, then an arcaded belfry with gold bells under a green copper dome capped by a small white lantern and a gold ball. I cannot name it.
identifications.cues: stacked tower stages - columns, clock, belfry, dome; blue clock face with gold hands; green copper dome; low white Georgian block
identifications.moreCertain: A location. A blue-and-gold clock face on a green-domed tower ought to be identifiable but I cannot place it, and 'white colonial building with a clock tower' fits many Canadian court houses and town halls.

identifications.answer: Three fishing boats moored at a wharf - white hulls with a dark blue sheer stripe, low open working decks aft, small wheelhouses forward, tall slender masts and horizontal outrigger or boom spars, in blue water beside a wooden dock with yellow bollards.
identifications.cues: tall bare masts with outrigger spars; open working deck aft of a forward wheelhouse; three boats rafted at a wharf
identifications.moreCertain: Nets, traps, drums or a hauler on deck - the gear would say what fishery. The hulls look like inshore lobster or longline boats.

identifications.answer: A Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer in full red serge - tan campaign hat, scarlet tunic with a blue shoulder yoke, white cross-strap, brown Sam Browne belt with a brass buckle and a hip pouch, dark blue breeches with a yellow leg stripe, tall brown riding boots.
identifications.cues: campaign hat; scarlet tunic; cross-strap and belt; yellow-striped blue breeches; riding boots
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing.

identifications.answer: Three white fishing boats with tall masts moored at a wharf in blue water. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: three white hulls with masts; wharf with bollards
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A red combine harvester on a stubble field - raised unloading auger over the cab, glazed cab, big drive wheel, and a header with a spoked reel at the front. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: spoked reel on the header; unloading auger; large front wheel; stubble
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: Toronto City Hall - the New City Hall by Viljo Revell. Two curved towers of unequal height, glazed on their concave inner faces and blank concrete on the outside, curving around a low saucer-shaped domed council chamber; both stand on a wide podium of repeated dark bays with a long blue reflecting pool in front.
identifications.cues: two unequal curved towers embracing a flying-saucer council chamber; podium and reflecting pool
identifications.moreCertain: Nathan Phillips Square's arches.

identifications.answer: The CN Tower and the domed stadium beside it, small - the tapering shaft with a saucer pod and antenna, a white dome on a dark base, a tree and a blue office slab.
identifications.cues: tapering shaft with pod and mast; adjacent white dome
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A railway well car with two stacked shipping containers - blue below, red-brown above - on ballasted track. Same as other renders in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: two stacked containers on a flat car; rail bogies
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: The Centre Block on Parliament Hill in Ottawa, small, with the Canadian flag on the Peace Tower - sandstone Gothic Revival wings under a green copper roof, corner towers, the central clock tower with a green spire, a dark slate spire behind, and a red-and-white maple leaf flag at the top.  [Same priming caveat as the other renders of this building.]
identifications.cues: maple leaf flag on the tower; central clock tower with green spire; Gothic arcade and green roof
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render. At this size the flag is carrying most of the identification.

identifications.answer: A farmers' market produce stall - a wooden trestle table under a green-and-white striped awning with a scalloped valance, crates of apples, potatoes and greens, sacks and a barrel. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: striped awning; produce crates; sacks and barrel
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A bulk cargo ship alongside a dock - long dark red hull, four deck cranes with raised booms, a white superstructure aft with an orange black-topped funnel, in blue water. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: long low hull with deck cranes; aft superstructure and funnel; dock in front
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A close crop of a mortared ashlar stone wall meeting at an inside corner, with snow along the top and drifted at the foot - brown stone on the left face, pale grey-brown stone on the right. Everything else has been cropped or painted away. This is a wall; I cannot say what it belongs to.
identifications.cues: coursed ashlar blocks; inside corner; snow on the coping and on the ground
identifications.moreCertain: Whatever stood above or beside it - gates, a railing, a lock chamber, a building.

identifications.answer: A bulk cargo ship at a dock - long dark red hull, deck cranes, white superstructure aft with an orange funnel. Same as other renders in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: long hull with cranes; aft superstructure and funnel
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A fishing village on bare granite - Peggy's Cove in Nova Scotia is my guess. A row of red, white and grey clapboard fishing shacks and boathouses stands on posts along a timber boardwalk over a deep blue cove, with small white dories and skiffs moored against it and their reflections in the water; a dense dark spruce forest runs behind, and the whole foreground is ice-scoured grey bedrock, swirled and striated, with rounded boulders, green weed and blue tide pools in the hollows.
identifications.cues: glacier-scoured striated granite as the whole foreground; fishing shacks on posts over a cove; spruce treeline; small moored boats
identifications.moreCertain: The lighthouse on the point, which is the thing that would settle Peggy's Cove. Without it this is any granite fishing cove on the Atlantic coast.

identifications.answer: A fishing village of red and white shacks on a boardwalk over a blue cove, with spruce behind and bare grey bedrock in front. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: shacks on a boardwalk; cove; scoured rock foreground
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A small clapboard cottage - pale yellow walls with white trim, a steep grey gable roof with a small gabled dormer over the door, a brick chimney, two dark-paned sash windows, a pale green front door, and a grey picket fence with a gate in front of rounded green bushes bearing red berries or flowers. A Maritime or rural Canadian house; I cannot name it.
identifications.cues: steep gable with a central dormer; clapboard with white trim; picket fence and flowering shrubs; brick chimney
identifications.moreCertain: A distinguishing detail - a green gable, a verandah, an outbuilding. If a specific literary or heritage house is intended, nothing in the picture says which.

identifications.answer: A person dressed for winter standing still - dark skin, a red knitted toque with a white pompom, a blue parka with white cuffs, a red scarf, red mittens, grey trousers with white boot cuffs, brown boots.
identifications.cues: pompom toque; parka, scarf and mittens; winter boots
identifications.moreCertain: Nothing identifying - this is a generic winter pedestrian.

identifications.answer: A small clapboard cottage - pale yellow walls with white corner boards, a steep grey gable roof with a small gabled dormer, a red brick chimney, two dark sash windows, a pale green front door, and a grey picket fence with a gate in front of green bushes bearing red berries. A rural Canadian or Maritime house; I cannot name it.
identifications.cues: steep gable with a central dormer; clapboard and white trim; picket fence and berry bushes; brick chimney
identifications.moreCertain: Anything specific - a verandah, green gables, an orchard, a setting. As drawn this is a generic storybook cottage.

identifications.answer: A shoreline - conifer treeline, a sandy bank, turquoise water and a grey gravel foreshore with green shrubs. Same as another render in this set, at a small size.
identifications.cues: treeline, water band, gravel shore
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A chateau-style grand railway hotel, small - red brick, green copper roofs, conical corner turrets, a tall central tower with a dark steep roof and spire, on a cliff with conifers. The Chateau Frontenac in Quebec City is the obvious candidate.
identifications.cues: chateauesque massing with a dominant central tower; green roofs; red brick; cliff-top siting
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render; the terrace or the river.

identifications.answer: A small yellow clapboard cottage with a grey gable roof, a dormer, a brick chimney, a picket fence and green bushes with red berries. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: gable with dormer; picket fence; berry bushes
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A public toboggan slide below a boardwalk - a timber launch tower at the left end of a boardwalk edged with green iron railing, green lamp posts with white globes, benches and a small shelter with people on it, and below, four people riding wooden sleds down parallel lanes of snow.  [On the larger render of this subject I guessed Quebec City's Dufferin Terrace. That guess came from the green ironwork plus the slide, not from a label.]
identifications.cues: timber launch tower at the head of the run; parallel snow lanes with toboggans; green ironwork railing and globe lamps along a boardwalk
identifications.moreCertain: The building behind the terrace, or the river below it.

identifications.answer: The Centre Block on Parliament Hill in Ottawa with the flag on the Peace Tower, small - sandstone Gothic Revival wings under a green copper roof, corner towers, a central clock tower with a green spire and a Canadian flag, and a dark spire behind.  [Same priming caveat: the method document names this building.]
identifications.cues: maple leaf flag on a central clock tower; Gothic arcade under a green roof; symmetrical sandstone wings
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A railway dome car - a stainless-steel passenger coach with horizontal fluting along its lower body, a blue window band and a row of square windows, standing on ballasted track, with a raised glazed observation dome rising above the roof over the forward half and a vestibule and end door at the right.
identifications.cues: raised glazed dome on the roof of a passenger coach; fluted stainless body with a blue band; bogies on track
identifications.moreCertain: A locomotive, or a railway name on the letterboard. A dome car of this kind says transcontinental passenger train, but nothing here says which railway.

identifications.answer: A red and white articulated tram or streetcar on street rails. Same as other renders in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: articulated red body; street track
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A stand of five spruce or fir trees on grey ground with boulders. Same as another render in this set, smaller.
identifications.cues: conical tiered conifer crowns; boulders
identifications.moreCertain: A larger render.

identifications.answer: A person cycling in winter clothes - leaning forward over the handlebars of a red-framed bicycle with spoked wheels and pedals, wearing a blue parka with white cuffs, a red scarf, red mittens, grey trousers, brown boots and a white helmet.

whatIsProven: All 179 renders were handed over by the quiet hand-off under opaque 16-hex names, with the keymap written to a directory outside the working area. The build's own leak checks held: every render name is 16 hex characters, no handed-over file carried a leaking token, no PNG carried metadata, and every render is length-padded so file size cannot relink it. All 179 were also matte-padded to one size, so the size ladder could not be told from the diagnostics.

Every one of the 179 answers was written before the keymap, the contract, the level documents, the reference photographs or the asset sources were opened. `verify-art commit` froze them at sha256 c74356dc..., and `score` re-checked that hash against the file it read.

The identifier read only: the hand-off directory, READ-ME-FIRST.txt, answers.json, what the command printed, `--help`, the Makefile and scripts/verify-art.mjs. scripts/lib/art-handoff.mjs and scripts/lib/art-score.mjs were not opened.
